test_vectors: 15 deterministic inline tests use only alloc, core, and canonical ABI types; no external bytes import or additional crate dependency.

Length-only boundary checks cover zero, exact limits, one byte over, the default 64 MiB limit, u32::MAX, and usize::MAX without large allocations; unrepresentable lengths are exercised when supported by the target.
Arc conversion and shared adoption preserve allocation identity, storage variant, reference counts, and bytes after another owner is dropped.
Bytes sliced from prefix:body:suffix to 7..11 retain the body range, original pointer, and Bytes variant; 7..7 exercises an empty visible slice over nonempty backing.
Vector transfer preserves the visible body bytes and allocation pointer with capacity 64 and length 4; empty vectors with spare capacity are accepted at a zero limit.
Borrowed slice [0, 255, 128, 123] is copied into Shared storage and remains unchanged when the source is overwritten.
Every entry point accepts empty input at zero limit and rejects nonempty input at zero limit or four visible bytes at limit three.
Errors verify PayloadTooLarge, Decode, u32::MAX byte offset, zero schema and field identifiers, and static payload-free detail; rejected shared inputs release their consumed Arc owner.
Invalid UTF-8, embedded NUL, incomplete JSON, trailing commas, lone surrogate escapes, and trailing content are preserved without content validation.
Decoded limits of zero, one, and u32::MAX do not change payload admission.
